skill_short_description: Agentic mitogenome phylogenomics pipeline (multi-gene supermatrix -- extract PCGs+rRNA, align, trim, concatenate, species tree) with optional gene-tree concordance, ANI, and codon-usage branches. Rebuilt from the MitoTree Nextflow pipeline as a checkpointed BettaMt-pattern skill. Deliberately excludes divergence-time dating (MCMCtree/PAML) -- unreliable from mitogenome-only data.
